articles.title: PayPal expands stablecoin push as crypto assets factor into Q2 results
articles.snippet: PayPal highlighted growth of stablecoins and AI-driven payment tools in Q2 while reporting $8.68 billion in revenue and an $81 million crypto-related earnings adjustment.

articles.title: The Dumbest-Looking AI Prompt Just Beat Months of Careful Game-Design Prompt Engineering
articles.snippet: The dev told Claude Opus 5 to be "utterly perfect" and left the rest up to the model—the results turned out to be utterly perfect, for an AI model.

articles.title: Stocks Just Topped Crypto on Hyperliquid. ARK Says That Changes Everything
articles.snippet: For the first time, real-world assets—stocks, commodities, and market indices—outpaced crypto on the world's biggest decentralized derivatives exchange.
